proposed.text: A rectangular timber beam has section modulus S = 1,200,000 mm^3 and supplied allowable bending stress Fb = 11 MPa. What maximum moment reaches the allowable bending limit?

rationale.correct: At the allowable limit, M = Fb x S = 11 N/mm^2 x 1,200,000 mm^3 = 13,200,000 N-mm = 13.2 kN-m.
rationale.takeaway: Use N and mm consistently, then convert N-mm to kN-m.
